title: Binding a Private Rate Increase to Held Days: Therapeutic Closing Charge
content:
**Compliance note — Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations, therapeutic closing charge.** A private rate increase binds a resident only through notice. Accordingly, for the therapeutic closing daily charge, the current schedule effective 2026-07-01 reaches a Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency agreement signed before 2026-07-01 only through the written rate notice.

1. Where the agreement was signed before 2026-07-01 and its rate notice was delivered fewer than the agreement's rate-change notice days before 2026-07-01, or on or after 2026-07-01, the current schedule prices the calendar days from the later of 2026-07-01 and the date falling those notice days after the delivery through the therapeutic closing entry's last day, never more than the entry's days, and the prior schedule prices the entry's remaining days.
2. Where the agreement was signed before 2026-07-01 and carries no rate notice, the prior schedule prices every day of the entry.
3. Where otherwise (an agreement signed on or after 2026-07-01, a rate notice delivered at least the rate-change notice days before 2026-07-01, or no such agreement on file), the current schedule prices the calendar days from 2026-07-01 through the therapeutic closing entry's last day, never more than the entry's days, and the prior schedule the rest.

The agreement read is the resident's current Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency agreement: the agreement that is active, else the one in its notice period, else the one converted to another payer source. What is read from it is the date the agreement was signed, the date its written rate notice was delivered, and the agreement's rate-change notice days.

**Cases.** Cases, writing D for the agreement's rate-change notice days (an agreement signed before 2026-07-01): a rate notice delivered D less one days before 2026-07-01 is fewer than D days before it, and the current schedule starts on the date D days after the delivery, which falls one day after 2026-07-01, on 2026-07-02; a rate notice delivered exactly D days before 2026-07-01 is not fewer, and the current schedule starts on 2026-07-01 itself; a rate notice delivered on or after 2026-07-01 starts the current schedule on the date D days after the delivery; with no rate notice at all, every day of the therapeutic closing entry is a prior-schedule day. In every case the current-schedule days are the calendar days from that start date through the entry's last day, never more than the entry's days.
